name: pv-dimensionality-reduction: filter/wrapper diagnostics for endogenous PV power forecasting
description: MATLAB code for short-term photovoltaic power forecasting from the post-inverter signal alone (no exogenous meteorological inputs), framed as a geometric compression of a lagged-power window. Seven dimensionality-reduction techniques are assessed with two complementary diagnostics: a model-free filter measuring geometry preservation, and a wrapper based on an Extreme Learning Machine, all reported against a shared accuracy-frugality trade-off.
